name: tienda-regalos-pos
description: Regalos & Personalizados POS - Sistema de Gestión Comercial con Presupuestos Paraguay

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build && npm run test:ruc
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma db push --skip-generate && NODE_ENV=production node dist/server.js
scripts.migrate:dev: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
